title: Factory constructors can't be named 'new'.
summary: Try removing the 'new' keyword or changing it to a different name.

title: The factory constructor '…' must have a body or redirection after all augmentations are applied.
summary: Try adding a body or redirection to the introductory declaration, or providing an augmentation with a body or redirection.
message_templates: The factory constructor '{}' must have a body or redirection after all augmentations are applied.

title: Top-level declarations can't be declared to be 'factory'.
message_templates: Top-level declarations can't be declared to be 'factory'.

title: A 'factory' constructor can't have initializers.
summary: Try removing the 'factory' keyword to make this a generative constructor, or removing the initializers.

title: A non-redirecting 'factory' constructor must have a body.
summary: Try adding a body to the constructor.
message_templates: A non-redirecting 'factory' constructor must have a body.
